text:
After a challenging evening, we thank you for your full message, and we are sorry that your journey with Aurelia Skyways and your companion animal was not handled to the standard you were entitled to expect. You have explained that the condition of the cabin, the level of attention during transit, and the handling of your concern afterward left you distressed and disappointed. We have reviewed the account with care and recognize how upsetting it is when a trusted travel arrangement does not feel safe or reassuring.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk takes such concerns seriously, because companion travel must be managed with calm attention, clear communication, and consistent care from the first check-in stage through arrival. Our records show that guidance is provided before departure, and that the cabin team is expected to monitor animals throughout the flight and respond promptly to signs of discomfort. If any part of that process fell short, we regret it and will address it with the relevant service teams so that the matter is properly reviewed and corrective action is considered.

<<FACT F120>>

We also note your concern about cabin overheating, which is a serious welfare matter for any animal in our care. The standard remedy for that incident is set out in our internal handling guidance, and <<FACT F111>>. Please be assured that we treat such events as a quality and welfare priority, and we are escalating your report for further examination against cabin logs, crew notes, and the available service record. Where a review identifies failings, we act on them so that future journeys are safer and more dependable.

While this response cannot undo the distress you experienced, it does confirm that your complaint has been logged for formal attention and that your concerns have not been dismissed. Aurelia Skyways remains committed to dependable companion travel, and we appreciate the opportunity to review this matter with the seriousness it deserves.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
